WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as avg_humid_per_equip
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_humid_per_equip) as overall_avg_humid
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.equipref,
    s1.avg_humid_per_equip,
    s1.avg_humid_per_equip - s2.overall_avg_humid as diff_from_overall
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.overall_avg_humid IS NOT NULL
    AND s1.avg_humid_per_equip > s2.overall_avg_humid
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_humid_per_equip) as avg_of_step3_col2
  FROM step3
)
SELECT 
  s3.equipref,
  s3.avg_humid_per_equip,
  s3.diff_from_overall,
  s3.avg_humid_per_equip - s4.avg_of_step3_col2 as final_difference
FROM step3 s3
CROSS JOIN step4 s4
WHERE s4.avg_of_step3_col2 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY final_difference DESC
LIMIT 10
